mapper.select: select * from ai_quota_reservation where receipt_key=#{receipt} for update
mapper.update: update ai_quota_reservation set state='REFUND_DUE',stage='ASR_NOT_SENT', decision_reason='ASR_NOT_SENT',next_attempt_at=now(3),completed_at=null,updated_at=now(3) where receipt_key=#{receipt} and fence_version=#{fence} and owner_token is null and state in ('PREPARED','RESERVED','UNCERTAIN','RETAINED') and stage in ('PRE_RESERVE','ASR_STARTED')

update ai_quota_reservation set generation=#{generation},used_after_reserve=#{used},state='RESERVED', request_lease_until=date_add(now(3),interval 120 second),updated_at=now(3) where receipt_key=#{receipt} and state='PREPARED' and owner_token is null and request_lease_until > now(3)

update ai_quota_reservation set stage=case when stage='ASR_STARTED' then stage else #{stage} end, request_lease_until=date_add(now(3),interval 120 second),updated_at=now(3) where receipt_key=#{receipt} and state='RESERVED' and owner_token is null and request_lease_until > now(3)

update ai_quota_reservation set state=#{state},stage=case when stage='ASR_STARTED' then stage else 'RESULT_CLASSIFIED' end,decision_reason=#{reason}, next_attempt_at=now(3),updated_at=now(3),completed_at=case when #{state}='RETAINED' then now(3) else null end where receipt_key=#{receipt} and state in ('PREPARED','RESERVED') and owner_token is null and request_lease_until > now(3) and (#{state}<>'REFUND_DUE' or stage<>'ASR_STARTED')
mapper.select: select * from ai_quota_reservation where state in ('PREPARED','RESERVED','REFUND_DUE') and next_attempt_at <= now(3) and (owner_token is null or claim_until <= now(3)) and (state='REFUND_DUE' or request_lease_until <= now(3)) order by next_attempt_at,id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update ai_quota_reservation set owner_token=#{owner},fence_version=fence_version+1, claim_until=date_add(now(3),interval 60 second),attempt_count=attempt_count+1,updated_at=now(3) where id=#{id} and fence_version=#{fence} and state in ('PREPARED','RESERVED','REFUND_DUE') and (owner_token is null or claim_until <= now(3)) and (state='REFUND_DUE' or request_lease_until <= now(3)) and next_attempt_at <= now(3)

update ai_quota_reservation set state=#{state},last_error_code=#{error},owner_token=null,claim_until=null, completed_at=now(3),updated_at=now(3) where id=#{id} and owner_token=#{owner} and fence_version=#{fence} and claim_until > now(3)

update ai_quota_reservation set last_error_code=#{error},owner_token=null,claim_until=null, next_attempt_at=date_add(now(3),interval 60 second),updated_at=now(3) where id=#{id} and owner_token=#{owner} and fence_version=#{fence} and claim_until > now(3)
